title: Can Tabular In-Context Learners Generalize to Biomolecular Property Prediction?
abstract: arXiv:2606.31126v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Predicting biomolecular properties from limited labeled data is a central bottleneck in protein engineering and small-molecule design. As strong pretrained encoders now supply rich fixed-length representations, the difficulty has shifted from representation learning to building a data-efficient predictor for the few-shot regime. Tabular foundation models such as TabPFN and TabICL perform this prediction through in-context inference after pretraining on synthetic tables. We test whether they can act as flexible interpolators over informative fixed biomolecular representations. Treating each method as a predictor-representation pair, we evaluate across two domains. On ProteinGym, TabPFN3-ESMC600M is competitive with leading supervised-substitution entries and obtains the lowest MSE among the leaderboard-context rows considered, while Kermut remains stronger by Spearman. translated_title: 表格上下文学习者能否泛化到生物分子性质预测？
translated_abstract: 从有限的标注数据预测生物分子性质是蛋白质工程和小分子设计中的一个核心瓶颈。随着强大的预训练编码器如今能够提供丰富的固定长度表示，难点已从表示学习转向为小样本场景构建数据高效的预测器。TabPFN和TabICL等表格基础模型在合成表格上完成预训练后，可通过上下文推理来执行此类预测。我们测试了它们能否作为在信息丰富的固定生物分子表示之上运作的灵活插值器。将每种方法视为预测器-表示对，我们在两个领域进行了评估。在ProteinGym上，TabPFN3-ESMC600M与领先的监督替换模型条目具有竞争力，并在所考虑的排行榜上下文行中取得了最低的MSE，而Kermut在Spearman相关性上仍更胜一筹。在模运算和连续留出设置下，性能显著降低……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文评估了TabPFN和TabICL等表格基础模型能否作为小样本场景下的数据高效预测器泛化到生物分子性质预测任务，发现在ProteinGym上TabPFN3-ESMC600M与领先的监督方法具有竞争力并取得最低MSE，但Kermut在Spearman相关性上仍更强，且在更难的划分设置下性能明显下降。
en_tdlr: This paper tests whether tabular foundation models like TabPFN and TabICL can act as flexible, data-efficient predictors over fixed biomolecular representations, finding that TabPFN3-ESMC600M is competitive on ProteinGym and achieves the lowest MSE among leaderboard-context rows, while Kermut remains stronger by Spearman and performance drops substantially under harder holdout settings.
